faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our CBD products

q1.question: Are CBD products legal?
q1.answer: Yes, our CBD products are perfectly legal in France. They contain less than 0.2% THC, in accordance with European regulations.

q2.question: How do I choose the right concentration?
q2.answer: Start with a low concentration (5-10%) if you're a beginner, then gradually increase according to your needs.

q3.question: What are the delivery times?
q3.answer: We ship within 24h and delivery is free for orders over €50. Allow 2-3 business days for receipt.

q4.question: Can I return my products?
q4.answer: Yes, you have 14 days to return your unopened products. Return shipping is on us.
